items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: Matter of fact, my dad was, he's a very strict man, you know.

ctx.x: Nicholas Mitchell. Yeah. And he was from Pointe, from New Roads. Right. Did he talk a lot about New Roads or his family background in that era, in New Roads?

No, not to me he didn't, you know. You see, he might have talked, I got a lot of information from my brother Ulysses because, see, Ulysses was, looked like Ulysses was his favorite. Well he didn't tell none of us too much when we was younger, you know, about nothing. But after we got grown, you know, before he died he did most of talking to him. Matter of fact, my dad was, he's a very strict man, you know. Like when we were coming up, he wouldn't lie us out the yard or nothing and all that. I saw the guys be…
Meaning what, why? To us, you know. I mean we used to get a lot of whippings.
